Node.js

endpoints.desc: Downloads a .gguf format model from Hugging Face into the local secure vault.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "repo_id": "unsloth/llama-3-8b",
    "filename": "llama-3-8b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf"
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/models/download', json=payload)
print(res.json())

params.name: model_id
params.desc: The local ID of the model.

params.name: gpu_layers
params.desc: Number of layers to offload to GPU.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "model_id": "llama-3-8b-instruct",
    "gpu_layers": -1,
    "context_size": 8192
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/models/load', json=payload)
print(res.json())
